description: This file implements the ListCommand class for listing and managing HIDL HALs in Android, including fetching service info, generating VINTF manifests, and command-line parsing.

classes.name: ListCommand
classes.description: Class implementing commands to list and manage HIDL HALs, including fetching service info, generating manifests, and command-line parsing.

methods.name: GetName
methods.description: Returns the command name 'list'.

methods.name: getSimpleDescription
methods.description: Returns a brief description 'List HIDL HALs.'.

methods.name: parseCmdline
methods.description: Retrieves the command line for a given process ID.

methods.name: getCmdline
methods.description: Returns cached or parsed command line for a process ID.

methods.name: removeDeadProcesses
methods.description: Removes dead or current process ID from a list of PIDs.

methods.name: getPartition
methods.description: Gets the partition (system, vendor, etc.) for a process ID.

methods.name: resolvePartition
methods.description: Infers partition based on package and process info.

methods.name: match
methods.description: Checks if a manifest instance matches a FqInstance and transport.

methods.name: getVintfInfo
methods.description: Retrieves VINTF info for a given FqInstance and transport.

methods.name: getDeviceManifest
methods.description: Returns the device HAL manifest.

methods.name: getDeviceMatrix
methods.description: Returns the device compatibility matrix.

methods.name: getFrameworkManifest
methods.description: Returns the framework HAL manifest.

methods.name: getFrameworkMatrix
methods.description: Returns the framework compatibility matrix.

methods.name: getVintfInfo
methods.description: Aggregates VINTF info from device/ framework manifests and matrices.

methods.name: getPidInfo
methods.description: Fetches binder PID info for a process.

methods.name: getPidInfoCached
methods.description: Returns cached PID info or fetches if not cached.

methods.name: shouldFetchHalType
methods.description: Checks if a HAL type should be fetched based on configuration.

methods.name: tableForType
methods.description: Returns the table corresponding to a HAL type.

methods.name: forEachTable
methods.description: Iterates over all relevant tables.

methods.name: postprocess
methods.description: Post-processes tables, sorts, and enriches entries.

methods.name: addEntryWithInstance
methods.description: Adds a HAL instance entry to a VINTF manifest.

methods.name: addEntryWithoutInstance
methods.description: Adds a HAL entry without specific instance info to a manifest.

methods.name: dumpVintf
methods.description: Outputs a VINTF manifest XML.

methods.name: dumpTable
methods.description: Outputs a human-readable table of entries.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Performs the dump operation, either to stdout or file.

methods.name: putEntry
methods.description: Adds an entry to a specific HAL type table.

methods.name: fetchAllLibraries
methods.description: Fetches all passthrough libraries via IServiceManager.

methods.name: fetchPassthrough
methods.description: Fetches passthrough service info.

methods.name: fetchBinderized
methods.description: Fetches binderized services info.

methods.name: fetchBinderizedEntry
methods.description: Fetches detailed info for a binderized service.

methods.name: fetchManifestHals
methods.description: Fetches HALs declared in VINTF manifests.

methods.name: fetchLazyHals
methods.description: Fetches lazy HALs declared in VINTF.

methods.name: hasHwbinderEntry
methods.description: Checks if a hwbinder entry exists.

methods.name: hasPassthroughEntry
methods.description: Checks if a passthrough entry exists.

methods.name: fetch
methods.description: Main fetch routine for all HAL info.

methods.name: initFetchTypes
methods.description: Initializes the set of HAL types to fetch.

methods.name: registerAllOptions
methods.description: Registers command-line options.

methods.name: parseArgs
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main execution entry for the command.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Prints usage information.
